title: Replace the misleading installed stub with the real CLI launcher
summary: Install mcp-agent-mail as a launcher for the repository virtualenv and preserve arguments and exit codes.
diff_sketch: Generate a small exec wrapper in scripts/install.sh that invokes .venv/bin/python -m mcp_agent_mail.cli "$@"; replace tests that pin the false non-CLI response.
risk: installer must embed the correct checkout path; fail clearly if its virtualenv is absent

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: The canonical executable rejects every CLI workflow.

anchor_quote: Agents should be able to discover and execute the canonical surface directly.
anchor_pattern: Canonical executable dispatches to one implementation.
counter_example: A command that ignores all arguments and falsely denies that its CLI exists.

title: Make bare invocation side-effect free
summary: Show top-level help when no command is supplied instead of attempting to start a second server.
diff_sketch: Use Typer no_args_is_help=True and remove the callback that calls serve_http.
risk: callers relying on undocumented bare-command daemon startup must switch to explicit serve-http

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: An exploratory invocation can contend with the live server database.

counter_example: Starting a daemon as a help fallback.

title: Add machine-readable capability discovery
summary: Expose version, invocation, exit-code contract, key commands, MCP discovery resources, and output modes through capabilities --json.
diff_sketch: Add a read-only top-level capabilities command with stable JSON and concise human rendering.
risk: payload becomes a public contract and requires additive evolution

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Every new agent needs surface discovery.

anchor_quote: Robots need a stable way to learn the interface.
counter_example: Mining Rich help output to discover machine contracts.

title: Add paste-ready robot documentation
summary: Provide robot-docs guide with compact MCP and CLI onboarding, identity semantics, and recovery rules.
diff_sketch: Add an explicit robot-docs Typer group and guide command supporting text and JSON.
risk: guidance can drift; pin core contract in tests

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Startup guidance affects every automated client.

anchor_quote: Documentation should be executable guidance, not prose archaeology.
counter_example: Identity tools reported without explaining whether reconciliation is appropriate.

title: Add JSON to mail status
summary: Make routing diagnostics directly parseable and keep human output unchanged by default.
diff_sketch: Build one status payload and branch to JSON or Rich table rendering.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Routing diagnosis is a frequent recovery path.

anchor_quote: Diagnostic state should be data before decoration.
anchor_pattern: One payload, human and robot renderers.
counter_example: Parsing a table and duplicate key=value lines.

title: Make roster states self-interpreting
summary: Attach stable interpretation and recommended_action fields to every roster row so durable-only and transitional states are not mistaken for failures.
diff_sketch: Map each canonical state to an interpretation and an action, then include both fields in the shared roster projection.
risk: wording becomes a stable API field; state values remain unchanged

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: The shared projection feeds CLI, MCP tool, and resource consumers.

anchor_quote: A status response should say what it means and what to do next.
counter_example: durable_only interpreted as a broken route.

title: Document guard and identity MCP tools at tools/list
summary: Add use-when, non-use, side-effect, and recovery semantics to terse MCP tool descriptions.
diff_sketch: Expand function docstrings consumed by FastMCP tools/list without changing schemas.
test_plan: tests/test_guard_tools.py and MCP tools/list regression assertions

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Descriptions guide tool choice before execution.

anchor_quote: Tool selection guidance belongs in the tool description.
counter_example: An empty tool description for a mutating operation.

title: Preserve the canonical name in generated usage
summary: Ensure launcher-driven help and errors say mcp-agent-mail instead of exposing the Python module implementation.
diff_sketch: Pass the launcher-provided MCP_AGENT_MAIL_PROG_NAME to Typer's prog_name.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Every help and usage error displays the program name.

anchor_quote: Errors should name the command the user actually invoked.
counter_example: Usage: python -m mcp_agent_mail.cli after invoking mcp-agent-mail.

title: Route common command aliases to the canonical CLI
summary: Keep existing agentmail spelling variants as symlinks to the one real launcher rather than divergent stubs.
diff_sketch: Point installer-created variants to the canonical launcher.
risk: aliases now expose real functionality instead of rejecting all input

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Existing aliases are global entry points.

anchor_quote: Reasonable spelling variants should converge on one implementation.
counter_example: Multiple names all point to a false stub.

title: Make launcher installation ordered and recoverable
summary: Install the launcher only after the repository and virtualenv exist and emit an actionable reinstall command if the environment later disappears.
